title: Lloyd Price band repertoire and playing for love of it
summary: Gil's arrangements, Rhapsody in Blue, Tangerine; band as good as Basie.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: So you were doing all the kind of standard Lloyd Price material but-
No, we did more than his material, because Gil actually wrote a lot of good instrumental things for me, for Lloyd's band.
So besides his hits, his hit records, you all did his hit records.

Yeah. Now Gil wrote a beautiful arrangement on Rhapsody in Blue. Lloyd would do that kind of material? Yes, and we did Old Man River, a concert style. And man, that band was so good, we would play Jobs without Lloyd. Some of the promoters would book the band. Said Lloyd Price Band.
So besides doing Staggerly and those kind of things, when you got married and all those hits.

He did a thing called Tangerine, a big band, that was good too. Well I didn't know he had such a- That was one of the best, at that time that's the only band that I would say was next to Basie, as far as playing music. That band Lloyd had was so good. We were playing dances. Like the dance started at nine o'clock, and we would get over there sometimes a little after eight, and before they started collecting the tickets, we started playing. We just liked to play together that much. We started playing. And the doors are closed. And the people, they let the people come in. When the people come in, the band is really hot. Well and you know you're cooking. I'm just going over some more discography on you, and I see, when did you join the Lionel Hampton band?
